inlines.v: HISTRION'ICAL, a. [L. histrionicus, from histrio, a buffoon, an actor, or stage player.] Pertaining to a buffoon or comedian, or to a pantomime, who represents events or characters by gestures and dancing; belonging to stage-playing; befitting a theater; theatrical.
